audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart carried blanket 'Skill'; content and packet agree Naafiri rows 0-3, Fizz from level 6 onward.
audit.why: Pre-6 Fizz is a 550-range melee whose only escape is a 16s E; Naafiri wins trades. At 6, E untargetability dodges her W lock-on and Chum the Waters guarantees his all-in; Lich Bane extends the lead through items.
audit.corrected: Full sides flipped to match content/packet with rewritten whys.

audit.why: Spikes accurate and all four present: 3-5 punish the 16s E cooldown, 6 flips to Fizz (E dodges W, R guarantees engage), first item Fizz stays ahead, late is his.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digits; two bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad; the W auto-reset burst tell was unmentioned.
audit.why: Playful/Trickster is 16s at rank 1, 8s maxed — the single answer to Naafiri's combo. Fizz W is an auto-reset (the wind-up is the step-back cue, per missingInteractions). His passive flat-reduces damage from all sources, which taxes packmate hits. R is 120s.
audit.corrected: Numbers, the auto-reset tell and the passive-vs-pack interaction written in.

edits.before: Q-Q the bleed-consume on his last hits — the double dagger chunks harder than the lobby expects at one.
edits.after: Q-Q the bleed-consume on his last hits — Fizz is 550-range melee and the double dagger chunks him at one.

edits.before: Pack pressure begins: hounds chase what you Q — trade where the dogs can pile on.
edits.after: Hounds chase what you Q — pile on before his escape hop starts deciding the trades.

edits.before: W online: the lock-on dive threatens anyone past the wave's midline. The lane plays scared now.
edits.after: W online: the lock-on dive threatens Fizz whenever his 16s Playful / Trickster is down.

edits.before: Q-E strings on every contact — the pack heals you through trades and the bleed math compounds.
edits.after: Q-E strings while his R is offline — the pack heals through trades and the bleed compounds.

edits.before: R online: the vision sweep plus bigger pack makes every roam a scheduled accident for a side lane.
edits.after: His 6 flips it: E dodges your W lock-on and Chum the Waters guarantees the all-in — disengage.

edits.before: First item spike: the W dive plus full string deletes squishies. Hunt the half-bars.
edits.after: Lich Bane plus the E dodge out-bursts you — commit only when his hop is visibly down.

edits.before: Late Naafiri flanks: R the sweep, W the carry, and let the pack vote on the peel.
edits.after: Shark R and item burst delete you first — farm with Q and flank only with his E down.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Eviscerate for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: 16s at rank 1, 8s maxed — the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo, so bait it before spending burst. - His R is 120s. - Your E (11s) is the emergency; your R (110s) is the opportunity — never swap them.

edits.before: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation.
edits.after: His W wind-up auto opens the burst — hold your W, ride it out untargetable, and re-engage as he lands.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Chasing him under tower into an E hop wastes the whole pack — his passive flat-reduces the dogs' small hits.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Fizz wins by hopping over your W lock-on with Playful / Trickster, then landing the shark and one-shotting you on the way down.
